summary: The Hashing module provides utilities for generating, attaching, validating, and managing URL hashes to secure URLs against tampering and ensure session integrity. It handles hash creation using SHA1, URL parameter manipulation, URL encoding/decoding (including for French characters), and special workflows for hash validation and timeout handling.
purpose: To prevent URL tampering, ensure authenticity via salted hashes, and enforce session timeouts by validating URL hashes at page-level and request-level, including supporting multi-language URL encoding cases.

workflows.name: Add Hash to Embedded URL
steps: Input text containing multiple URLs delimited by <|| and ||>.
For each delimited URL, replace it with the same URL but with URLHash parameter added.

workflows.name: Add URL Hash to URL
steps: Check if URL already contains URLHash parameter.
If reGenerate is true, remove existing URLHash and re-add.
Hash the URL (with salt) and append URLHash parameter.

workflows.name: Validate URL Hash
steps: Extract URLHash and rebuild base URL (up to URLHash parameter).
Compare new hash with provided URLHash.
Allow session if valid, otherwise try space-to-plus substitution and recheck.
If invalid, log timeout, logout session, redirect to timeout page.

workflows.name: HttpRequest Rebuild/Redirect
steps: Strip domain and any pre-existing URLHash from request URL.
Return page and query string only.
Rebuild full/relative URL for redirection using domain and rebuilt query.

workflows.name: Decode French URL Artifacts
steps: Replace French-encoded characters in URL with their plain equivalents.

business_rules: A hash is generated for the URL using SHA1 and a hardcoded salt.
If hash of URL up to the URLHash matches the URLHash parameter, session/URL is valid.
If hash validation fails, session is timed out and user is logged out.
URLHash parameter must always be present for validation to pass.
French special characters and browser-specific encodings are handled explicitly.
validations: URLHash parameter must exist and match hash of URL up to parameter plus salt.
Session is validated according to hash comparison.
URL encoding/decoding must handle special cases (plus/spaces, French characters).
calculations: SHA1 hash of (URL up to URLHash + salt).
Query string manipulation to remove/replace URLHash.
conditions: If URLHash is missing, session is invalid.
If hash comparison fails even after space/plus substitution, session is invalid.
If query string lengths differ (old/new), further validation checks fail.
system_behavior: Logs timeouts for invalid hash sessions.
Redirects to timeout page on validation failure.
Manipulates and rebuilds URLs for redirection and validation.
exceptions: Hash validation failure triggers session logout and redirection.
Timeouts are logged with detailed information if session is not valid.
Handling of encoding exceptions for browser-specific cases.
content_gaps: Code fragments related to some functions (e.g. full implementation for URL decoding, French character handling, and edge browser cases) are partial.
Behavior for error handling outside hash validation is not described.
Dependency details for DB procedures and session handling are referenced but not fully specified.
